title: Which Christmas Story Character Are You?
subtitle: The manger had more than one role

questions.text: When God asks you to do something impossible, you...

options.text: Say yes before I have a plan.
Sleep on it — and obey when I wake up.
Pack and start traveling toward the answer.
Sprint to tell the people I love.

questions.text: Pick the season you most relate to:

options.text: Carrying something holy nobody can see yet.
Quietly protecting someone I love.
Searching — following a sign I half understand.
Watching, faithfully, in an unimpressive job.

questions.text: How do you respond to a vision or a nudge from God?

options.text: I ponder it in my heart.
I do exactly what the angel said.
I show up — even if I miss the room and apologize later.
I deliver the message and let it land where it lands.

questions.text: Your love language for God is...

options.text: Surrender — a whispered yes.
Quiet, costly obedience.
Long pilgrimages with the best gifts I have.
Telling everyone what I just saw.

questions.text: Pick the verse that hits hardest:

options.text: Be it unto me according to thy word.
He did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him.
They presented unto him gifts.
Let us now go even unto Bethlehem.

questions.text: When good news shows up, you...

options.text: Carry it quietly until it's the right time.
Treat it like a sacred secret to steward.
Pack up and travel to see it firsthand.
Run to tell everyone, full volume.

questions.text: What's the moment that most resonates?

options.text: Holding a fragile, holy yes.
Realizing I have no room — and panicking.
Looking up at a sky full of glory.
Falling down to worship.

questions.text: If your role in the nativity were a one-liner, it'd be...

options.text: Behold the handmaid of the Lord.
He did as the angel had bidden him.
Fear not: I bring good tidings.
There was no room — but here's what I have.

mary.name: Mary the Yes
mary.description: Your courage is quiet. You said yes to something impossible and carried it in your heart through every hard moment after — the whole story rests on women like you.

joseph.name: Joseph the Steady
joseph.description: You don't get the big speeches, but you do exactly what the angel said. Your obedience is the quiet shelter someone else's calling rests on.

wise-men.name: The Wise Men
wise-men.description: You follow signs other people ignore. You travel a long way to worship, and when you find Him, you don't hold anything back — gold, frankincense, myrrh, all of it.

shepherds.name: The Shepherds
shepherds.description: You're at work — unglamorous, unnoticed — when the sky opens. Heaven announces big news to people just like you, and you can't help running to tell the rest of us.

innkeeper.name: The Innkeeper
innkeeper.description: You don't have it all together — your inn is full and your week is full and you almost missed Him. But you found a space, even if it was just a manger, and the kingdom moved in.

angel.name: The Announcing Angel
angel.description: You can't help announcing good news. You walk into rooms ready to say 'fear not' — because you've actually seen what God is doing and someone has to tell people.
